Read through rediacc_hooks/model_invocation.py (load_exceptions) by the pre-edit guard block_user_only_command, its pre-bash twin and check:ci-model-invocable-commands, so the three cannot disagree.

An entry is an OPERATOR RULING, never a BLOCKER entry: each names the file, the value its frontmatter keeps, and the ruling's date and verbatim quote. The gate refuses an entry without a ruling, a duplicate, a file that no longer exists, and a file that no longer carries the key exactly as listed.
The hook refuses any edit to this file: adding an exception is an operator decision, made with !.
